title: DIP: Dynamic In-Context Planner For Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.03199v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have shown strong potential for general natural language tasks with in-context examples. Existing In-Context Learning (ICL) approaches largely inherit the practice of autoregressive language models (ARLMs), incorporating all examples into a fixed prompt. However, applying this rigid, static-prompt paradigm to DLMs incurs substantial computational overhead, as the model must evaluate the maximum context length at every step. We address this inefficiency with a key discovery: the block-wise KV-cache mechanism inherent to DLM inference enables the \textit{low-cost dynamic adjustment of the context}. Following this intuition, our core idea is to start generation with a minimal prompt and progressively insert additional examples on the fly only when the generated tokens are of low confidence. tldr: 该论文提出DIP方法，利用扩散语言模型固有的分块KV缓存机制，从最小提示开始生成，仅在token置信度较低时才动态插入示例，从而以低成本实现上下文的动态调整并大幅降低计算开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DIP, which leverages the block-wise KV-cache mechanism inherent to diffusion language models to start generation with a minimal prompt and dynamically insert in-context examples only when token confidence is low, enabling low-cost dynamic context adjustment and substantially reducing computational overhead.
